provider: OpenRouter only -> Google Veo 3.1 Lite (default) or Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash (--model omni), no audio requested
policy: The last step of the bad-footage ladder (motion-and-ai.md §3): for shots the director's footage can't provide, or whose footage and free stock are unusable after the free fixes. May show the subjects (2026-11-10); never proof, never words put in someone's mouth; labelled AI-generated in the brief; approved per shot at Checkpoint 1 and per paid run. No raw footage is sent, only optional first/last still frames.
